title: Second half begins with Sactown on top
heading: 2003-04 Power Rankings: Week 16

rankings.summaryHtml: Six, eight, 10 more games without Webber? No prob, even with 19 of the last 32 games on the road. Of course, this assumes Webb doesn't miss a minute of May or June.
